'''Spaghetti''' was a substance.<ref name="tnr">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', which include the mention of spaghetti, to [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was attacked by a [[thernbee]] [[Species/Legends|creature]] while on the planet [[Almania]]. The thernbee tried to suck a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-dampening [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]] beast that Chewbacca was holding out of its [[Ysalamiri cage|cage]] similar to how one would suck spaghetti.<ref name="tnr" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Icon_Spaghetti.png|thumb|Spaghetti in ''Star Wars: Tiny Death Star'']]
Spaghetti was first mentioned in ''[[Wookiees Amok]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure written by [[Timothy M. Ryan]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published in [[Challenge 37|''Challenge'' 37]] in [[1989]]. In ''Wookies Amok'', spaghetti was [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], though noted as not pleasurable to watch the Hutt [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] eat it due to planet [[Branth]]'s [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] being very [[Water/Legends|humid]].<ref name="Challenge" /> As the adventure was released outside the [[Lucas Licensing]] process, it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Challenge">{{ChallengeCite|37|Wookiees Amok}}</ref>  As a result, spaghetti's first canonical mention is in ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', a [[1996]] novel written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="tnr" /> Spaghetti was set to make an appearance in the [[2013]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''; it would have appeared in the "Naboo Delicacies" food level,<ref name="tiny">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'' game files</ref> but the game was discontinued<ref name="gone">{{WebCite|url=http://www.gameinformer.com/b/news/archive/2014/10/03/disney-torpedoes-tiny-death-star-without-alerting-developer-nimblebit-in-advance.aspx|text=Disney Torpedoes Tiny Death Star Without Alerting Developer Nimblebit In Advance|author=Futter, Mike|date=2014-10-03|archivedate=20200429225306}}</ref> prior to Naboo Delicacies' launch. Spaghetti's game icon, depicting a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-colored dish served in a green bowl, could still be accessed in the game's files. The files also revealed that spaghetti would have been purchasable for two [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="tiny" />

In the "Gods from the Machine" Operation,<ref name="Operation">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=operation|Gods from the Machine}}</ref> which was introduced in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] video game, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', starting on [[April 18]], [[2017]],<ref name="PatchNotes">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/04182017/game-update-5.2-war-iokath|text=Game Update 5.2: The War for Iokath Patch Notes}}</ref> a game mechanic named "Spaghettification" is in effect during the player characters' [[Machine Gods crisis|fight]] against the [[Six Gods|droid]] [[Nahut]]. The combat occurs on<ref name="Operation" /> the world-sized artificial sphere<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Iokath}}</ref> [[Iokath]], in a [[Valley of the Machine Gods|chamber]] in which a [[singularity generator]] creates a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]], which constitutes a hazard that the player characters must avoid.<ref name="Operation" />

Due to the names of the ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' gameplay mechanics not necessarily representing [[in-universe]] concepts in all cases, this article refrains from assuming the term "spaghettification" exists in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Operation" /> In real life, "[[Wikipedia:Spaghettification|spaghettification]]" refers to the stretching of an object that is theorized to occur in the vicinity of [[Wikipedia:Black hole|black holes]] due to the said object experiencing associated extreme differences in gravitational forces.<ref name="Definition">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/spaghettification|text=Spaghettification|work=[https://www.dictionary.com Dictionary.com]|archivedate=20210522192635}}</ref>
